st: Feeding the microbiome with beans, tea and coffee

sec.p: In this newsletter you won't find superfoods. But beans.

sec.t: ff.92.2 One more organ: the microbiome
sec.p: The microbiome (the layer of microbes lining the gut) is increasingly linked to mood, blood sugar and disease.

sec.t: ff.92.3 Tea or coffee? Fuel for the microbiome
sec.p: The microbiome also has a sweet tooth for polyphenols.
